reasons: The site is within the Doncaster Main Urban Area at Wheatley, outside Green Belt, any conservation area and Flood Zones 2 and 3. It is an existing 8-bedroom HMO, and converting an existing rear outbuilding to a ninth bedroom is considered acceptable in principle. It makes effective use of previously developed land in accordance with Doncaster Local Plan Policies 1 and 10 and NPPF paragraphs 124 and 125. The Article 4 Direction removes permitted development rights only for C3 to C4 changes, so it does not prevent this application.

The proposal adds one bedroom to an existing HMO. The plans show a living area, private kitchen and en-suite alongside Bedroom 9, and no HMO concentration data was available. On that basis the proposal is considered acceptable under Doncaster Local Plan Policy 9 and NPPF paragraph 124, provided the outbuilding is conditioned to be used only as part of the single HMO, occupied by one person, and not as a separate self-contained dwelling.

The works are modest and sit to the rear of the property, with the main house unchanged. The outbuilding is retained in brick with a pitched roof, and a low glazed link crosses the yard. It is considered that the effect on residential amenity can be made acceptable by conditions. These require a rooflight and window privacy treatment, and approval of scaled and dimensioned drawings. The result is that neighbours' privacy, outlook and light, and the living conditions of occupiers, are protected in accordance with Doncaster Local Plan Policies 10, 44 and 45 and NPPF paragraph 135.

The outbuilding conversion and glazed link are small-scale, are located to the rear and are not considered to harm the character of the host property or the area. The submitted drawings lack heights and materials details, and the link is described inconsistently in the supporting documents. These matters can be resolved by conditions requiring dimensioned plans and approval of external materials. Subject to those conditions the design is considered acceptable under Doncaster Local Plan Policies 41, 42 and 44 and NPPF paragraphs 135 and 140.

The proposal adds one bedroom, creates no new access and makes no change to the two existing on-site parking spaces. No harm to highway safety is evident, so the impact on the highway is considered acceptable. Conditions will retain the existing spaces and secure cycle storage and refuse and recycling arrangements. This is in accordance with Doncaster Local Plan Policy 13 and NPPF paragraphs 115 to 117.

The site is in Flood Zone 1, so no sequential or exception test is required. The additional built form is small, being a 12.8 sq m glazed link across an existing yard. A condition will secure satisfactory surface water and foul drainage details, so the proposal is considered acceptable and would not increase flood risk elsewhere. This is in accordance with Doncaster Local Plan Policies 56 and 57, NPPF paragraphs 170, 176, 181 and 182, and Flood Risk SPD paragraph 5.2.4.
conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission. Reason: Required by Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans and documents listed on the decision notice. Reason: To ensure that the development is carried out in accordance with the application as approved.

The outbuilding and glazed link hereby permitted shall be used only as part of the single House in Multiple Occupation at 20 Willowmere Road. They shall not be occupied as a separate self-contained dwelling or let independently of the HMO. The outbuilding shall be occupied by no more than one person, and the HMO as a whole shall not be occupied by more than nine persons at any one time. Reason: To ensure the use remains an HMO as applied for, to control the intensity of the use and to protect residential amenity, in accordance with Doncaster Local Plan Policies 1, 9, 10 and 45.

Before development commences, scaled and dimensioned plans and elevations showing heights, boundary distances and yard dimensions shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details. Reason: To ensure a clear and accurate approved design and a satisfactory appearance, in accordance with Doncaster Local Plan Policies 41 and 44 and NPPF paragraph 140.

Before the glazed link and outbuilding conversion are constructed, details and samples of all external materials, including the roof covering, link framing and glazing, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details. Reason: To ensure the materials respect the host property and the character of the area, in accordance with Doncaster Local Plan Policies 41 and 44.

Before first occupation of Bedroom 9, any rooflight or window in the outbuilding that overlooks neighbouring land shall be fitted with obscure glazing or be non-opening below 1.7m above internal floor level, in accordance with details submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. It shall be retained as such thereafter. Reason: To protect the privacy of neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with Doncaster Local Plan Policy 44.

Before occupation of the ninth bedroom, details of secure, covered cycle storage for the occupants of the HMO shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved facilities shall be provided before occupation and retained thereafter. Reason: To provide cycle storage and promote sustainable transport, in accordance with Doncaster Local Plan Policy 13.

The two existing on-site car parking spaces shall be retained, kept available for parking and not used for any other purpose. Reason: To maintain adequate off-street parking and avoid additional on-street parking pressure, in accordance with Doncaster Local Plan Policy 13.

Before occupation of the ninth bedroom, details of refuse and recycling storage and collection arrangements, shown on a scaled plan, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved arrangements shall be implemented before occupation and retained thereafter. Reason: To ensure adequate waste storage that does not obstruct the highway, in accordance with Doncaster Local Plan Policy 13.

Before the glazed link is constructed, details of the means of disposal of surface water from the link roof and any new hard surfacing, and of foul drainage from the new en-suite and kitchen, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details. Reason: To ensure satisfactory drainage and that flood risk is not increased elsewhere, in accordance with Doncaster Local Plan Policy 56.
